entities.name: Naiva
entities.description: A young Temur hunter who stalls Nicol Bolas with questions, then is swayed by his offer and pulls a knife on her sister Baishya.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon and planeswalker who gives Naiva his self-serving account of his past, claims Ugin is not his twin, and offers her power if she brings him Yasova.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: The Spirit Dragon, said by Bolas to have fled, then to have been killed by Bolas in the Meditation Realm; his bones lie beneath the hedrons.

entities.name: Baishya
entities.description: A young whisperer in a trance inside the hedron, Naiva's twin.

entities.name: Yasova Dragonclaw
entities.description: The former Temur chief meditating in the hedron beside Baishya, sought by Bolas.

entities.name: Tae Jin
entities.description: A young Jeskai ghostfire warrior whom Naiva thinks of.

entities.name: Arcades Sabboth
entities.description: An elder dragon who ruled an empire; Bolas claims he planted doubts in his mind.

entities.name: Chromium Rhuell
entities.description: A surviving elder dragon who wanders in the guise of a helpful observer.

entities.name: Palladia-Mors
entities.description: A surviving ill-tempered elder dragon.

entities.name: Vaevictis Asmadi
entities.description: A surviving elder dragon who pillages and burns.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: A Dragonlord whom Yasova once distracted with the promise of food.

entities.name: The progenitor
entities.description: The shadowy being whose wing-beats birthed the dragons.

entities.name: Hedrons
entities.description: Rock cocoons that conceal Ugin's skeleton and that Bolas wonders about.

entities.name: Ugin's grave
entities.description: The canyon of hedrons cleaved by Ugin's falling body.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane Bolas says he named, as his home.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane Bolas threatens to destroy to prevent Ugin's rebirth.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: A plane where Bolas says Ugin tried to trap him with an artifact.

entities.name: The Meditation Realm
entities.description: A still-water construct between planes where Bolas claims he killed Ugin.

entities.name: Madara
entities.description: An island chain on Dominaria where Bolas fell after Ugin's death.

entities.name: The blind eternities
entities.description: The space between planes.

entities.name: The Elder Dragon Wars
aliases: the wars between the elder dragons
entities.description: A long war among dragons on Dominaria that Bolas says he left behind.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: A dragon tribe, mentioned indirectly.

events.summary: Bolas offers Naiva rule of the world if she tells him where Ugin is, and Naiva asks why he hates his twin.
events.quote: Why do you hate Ugin? He's your twin.

events.summary: Bolas denies that Ugin is his twin, calling it a story Ugin spread to share his glory.
events.quote: That's just a story he put about, trying to grab for a share of my glory and my triumph.

events.summary: Naiva realizes Bolas does not know where Ugin's body lies and tries to keep him distracted to protect Baishya.
events.quote: Somehow, amazingly, this powerful dragon did not know Ugin's body lay concealed beneath the hedrons.

events.summary: Naiva challenges Bolas that he was born together with Ugin, and he roars in anger and asks who told her.
events.quote: Of course that's not right! Who told you that?

events.summary: Bolas begins his account, claiming he woke first and woke Ugin, who flew only because he taught him.
events.quote: In this way he discovered flight or, I should say, I taught him that flight is what we dragons are made for.

events.summary: Naiva interrupts to say there were eight dragons, and Bolas swats a foreclaw down to knock her over.
events.quote: Do not interrupt me again!

events.summary: Bolas claims he alone dared to land on the ground and named the world Dominaria.
events.quote: So, I named our home Dominaria, because I claimed its song for myself.

events.summary: Bolas claims he avenged his sister's death on the humans while Ugin lost his nerve, then Ugin fled, vanishing.
events.quote: And so, he fled. He vanished, there one moment and then as if with the blink of the eye and a ripple through the air . . . GONE.

events.summary: Bolas claims he killed the sorcerers around him and founded academies, then fought wars with his siblings until Arcades retreated and Ugin returned in the middle of the final battle.
events.quote: One day, when I had finally driven that stubborn tyrant Arcades into retreat, Ugin returned.

events.summary: Bolas says Ugin mocked him atop the birth mountain and vanished, and Bolas felt rage and envy.
events.quote: In a ripple of warm wind, he was gone.

events.summary: Bolas says a spark of rage ignited him and he became a planeswalker, arriving at a mirror sea.
events.quote: With my next breath, I comprehended the whole: I had become a Planeswalker.

events.summary: Bolas claims he visited hundreds of worlds, found no other planeswalker, and returned home to share this with Ugin.
events.quote: I was the first among all sapient creatures to discover the possibility of traveling between planes.

events.summary: Bolas visits Arcades's kingdom, hears he last saw Ugin long ago, and plants doubts in his mind about his subjects.
events.quote: I insinuated a worm of doubt in his haughty mind

events.summary: Bolas claims he found Ugin floating in the Meditation Realm and that Ugin attacked him, leading to a long struggle across the planes.
events.quote: He attacked, viciously and without warning, all raw fury and malignant resentment.

events.summary: Bolas claims he killed Ugin in the Meditation Realm in self-defense, and the shockwaves hurled him back to Dominaria on Madara.
events.quote: There, purely in self-defense, I killed him.

events.summary: Bolas threatens Naiva, tells her Ugin plagued him later with a plan to trap him on Ixalan, and learns she says Ugin's bones lie beneath the hedrons.
events.quote: He has plagued me ever since, most recently with a misbegotten plan to trap me on Ixalan by means of a magical artifact.

events.summary: Bolas preys on Naiva's resentments toward Baishya and offers to make her the great hunter and leader.
events.quote: You could finally become the great hunter and leader you deserve to be.

events.summary: Bolas threatens to destroy Tarkir unless Naiva brings Yasova to him, and promises to clear her enemies.
events.quote: All you need do is bring me Yasova. Now.

events.summary: Naiva tells Bolas that Yasova is hiding right there.
events.quote: She's here. Right here. Hiding.

events.summary: Naiva crawls into the hedron, finds Baishya and Yasova, and presses her knife to Baishya's throat.
events.quote: Pulling her knife from its sheath, she pressed the blade against Baishya's vulnerable throat.

relations.note: Bolas says he killed Ugin and wants to ensure he never returns
relations.quote: So I believed when I killed him in the Meditation Realm.
There, purely in self-defense, I killed him.

relations.note: Naiva says he is Ugin's twin; Bolas denies it

relations.quote: Baishya had always been a burden heavier than a net of dead goblins.

relations.note: wars against Arcades and sows doubt in him
relations.quote: Arcades was disparaging me, hoping to make me lose my temper
Fetch her for me. Then you will receive your reward.

relations.note: grandmother and granddaughter; Yasova holds Baishya's hand in the hedron
relations.quote: while her right hand grasped Baishya's bare fingers with an affectionate clasp
